pages.text: Every Fabricator is built the same way:$(br)$(li)Lay a flat $(l)N×N square$() of $(item)Printer Casing$() on one level$(li)Place the $(l)controller$() in the $(l)center$() cell$(li)$(l)Right-click$() the controller to form$(br2)All base blocks sit on the controller's own Y level. The diagrams below show the four sizes — corner blocks are highlighted.

pages.title: Tier 5 — 3×3
pages.text: $(l)4$() Printer Casing + $(l)4$() corner $(item)Diamond Block$()s + $(item)Tier 5 Fabricator$() in the middle. The smallest Fabricator.

pages.title: Tier 6 — 5×5
pages.text: $(l)24$() Printer Casing + $(item)Tier 6 Fabricator$() in the center cell.

pages.title: Tier 7 — 7×7
pages.text: $(l)48$() Printer Casing + $(item)Tier 7 Fabricator$(). Clear a big flat platform first.

pages.title: Tier 8 — 9×9
pages.text: $(l)76$() Printer Casing + $(l)4$() corner $(l)Awakened Draconium$() blocks + $(item)Tier 8 Fabricator$(). Requires Draconic Evolution.

pages.title: If It Won't Form
pages.text: Forming checks every base cell. If a cell is wrong, the game names the exact coordinates that failed:$(br)$(li)$(l)Wrong / missing block$() — a base cell isn't Printer Casing$(li)$(l)T5 corner$() — a corner isn't a Diamond Block$(li)$(l)T8 corner$() — a corner isn't Awakened Draconium$(br2)Fix the named position and right-click the controller again. The controller must be dead-center, on the same Y as the base.
